newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Kovintrade delays OTC listing.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Kovintrade delays OTC listing.

text.p: Slovenian trading company Kovintrade d.d. said on Friday it will delay its listing on the over-the-counter market (OTC) of the Ljubljana bourse, originally set for October 21.

"We decided to delay the listing because we want to keep share transfers transparent. Therefore, we suggested that current shareholders have a priority right to purchase our shares," the company said in a statement.
It said a final decision on the delay and priority purchasing right would be taken at a shareholders' meeting on Tuesday.
Kovintrade completed its voucher privatisation in September.
